_readme: Configuration for .github/workflows/sync-domostats-schema.yml.
This repository is PUBLIC and the connector repository is private. Two of these
settings exist because of that asymmetry, not for convenience.
newReportPolicy: "opt-in" (default) or "auto".
Under opt-in, a report the connector has and this article does not gets a section
only once its key appears in documentedReportKeys. Domo cuts a release branch about
six weeks before customers see a feature, so "auto" would announce unreleased
reports in a public draft PR the night they merge to the connector's master.
Only set "auto" if this repository stops being public.
documentedReportKeys: report keys a human has cleared for documentation. Use the
`key` value from domostats-schema.json, for example "roleGrants". Adding a key
makes the next run generate its section, its field table, and its Details Pane row.
Column-level changes to reports the article already documents never need an entry
here: that report is already public, so syncing its columns discloses nothing new.
excludedReportKeys: reports to drop from the manifest entirely, so they are neither
added nor counted as undocumented. For genuinely internal reports such as
"buzzDataflow" that will never be customer-facing.
excludedSections: article section headings that intentionally have no connector
report behind them, so they are not reported as candidates for removal.
excludedColumns: column names the platform adds to every DataSet rather than the
connector schema declaring them. They are never reported as missing from the
manifest. Matched case- and separator-insensitively, across every report.
